summary: The daemon serves its bundled web app on 127.0.0.1:7410 by default. Open it with fractal web or st web; a single-use owner-only launch link establishes an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict browser session restricted to the client API. Missing assets or a configured person leave the daemon running and appear in doctor.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The loopback browser listener is enabled by default; --web-listen off disables it and --web-dist overrides share/fractal-web relative to the executable. Home Manager exposes webListen, with null disabling the listener. The separate opt-in tailnet publisher retains its explicitly configured port; examples use 7411.

downtime.detail: No fleet downtime. The running daemon adopts the bundled app and listener settings on its next normal restart.

manual.detail: No manual step for packaged installations. Custom binary layouts must install share/fractal-web or set --web-dist.

recovery.detail: Disable the listener with --web-listen off if the default port is already occupied.
